events.title: Odd Albrigtsen 4tet
events.description:
Odd Steinar Albrigtsen is an exciting Norwegian guitarist/ composer who currently lives in Oslo as a jazz musician. Fall 2026 Odd Albrigtsen 4tet embarks on tour with their latest album Winds. 
The band members met in New York after an exciting musical encounter and has since been on several tours and played concerts in Norway and Europe. Albrigtsen has earlier released the albums Mode, Morse and The North under his own name with critical acclaim.The album Winds was recorded in Barcelona after a tour in Spain. The Former album Morse Featuring Chris Cheek was recorded 2017 that also features, Gianni Gagliardi, Chris Cheek, Lars Ekman and Jesse Simpson.

Albrigtsen was born in the northern city of Tromsø, Norway ( 1985) and began playing drums at the age of 6 before switching to the guitar. Odd Steinar Albrigtsen started to study jazz at the conservatory in Trondheim, Norway. He then lived in Oslo and played with the great musicians on the Scandinavian jazz scene and after that he went to study at Aaron Copland School of Music in New York where he studied with great american jazz musicians such as Michael Mossman, David Berkman Paul Bollenbeck and Lage Lund. 

The musicians has otherwise played with people like Petter Wettre, Ben Van Gelder, Marc Copland, Tore Johansen, Gilad Hekselman, Mark Ferber, John Abercrombie.

events.title: MFA KERA AND BLACK HERITAGE – «THE AFROSOUL JOURNEY» – WITH: Reinhard Katemann-Herve Hartock-Charles Sammons
events.description: MFA KERA AND BLACK HERITAGE FEAT : Mike RUSSELL « THE AFROSOUL JOURNEY » Deutsch Seid mit dabei auf einer unvergesslichen und einzigartigen musikalischen Reise der Gruppe «Black Heritage» durch “schwarze Musik” mit der faszinierenden& charismatischen Vokalistin und Komponistin Mfa Kera aus Madagaskar, auch bekannt als „die VOICE“ (die Stimme) und dem außergewöhnlichen Gitarristen und Sänger Mike Russell aus Washington DC. Die Vielfalt und Fülle ihres reichen Repertoires und die hohe Qualität der Solistenund der Kompositionen lässt die Gruppe sowohl im Jazz als auch bei Weltmusikevents und Festivals am richtigen Platz sein. Black Heritageist bekannt für Afro Soul, Funk und Jazz Musik . Kera: Kera , die kreolische Wurzeln hat, wurde auf Madagaskar geboren und wuchs im Senegal auf. Nach ihrem Umzug nach Paris begann sie ihre berufliche Laufbahn als Sängerin von Blues und Gospel an der Seite von Memphis Slim und arbeitete mit Größen wie Mickey Baker, John Lee Hooker und Milton Buckner zusammen. Sie wurde eingeladen, im Film „The Adventure Of Jazz“ zu singen – einer Produktion, die von Stars wie Duke Ellington, Louis Armstrong, Lionel Hampton und George Benson angeführt wurde –, und veröffentlichte ihre ersten Aufnahmen im Rahmen einer Hommage an Mahalia Jackson. English Join the group „Black Heritage“ on an unforgettable and unique musical journey through „Black music,“ featuring the fascinating and charismatic vocalist and composer Mfa Kera from Madagascar—also known as „The Voice“—and the extraordinary guitarist and singer Mike Russell from Washington, D.C . The versatility and extreme richness of their repertoire and the high level of soloists and compositions and texts allows the group to fit on both Jazz and World music venues and festivals. Black Heritage is known for Afro-soul, funk, and jazz music . Kera: Of Creole extraction KERA was born in Madagascar and grew up in Senegal. After moving to Paris, she began her professional career singing the Blues and Gospel with Memphis Slim and working with such luminaries as Mickey Baker, John Lee Hooker and Milton Buckner. She was invited to sing in the Film „The Adventure Of Jazz“ which top billing were Duke Ellington, Louis Armstrong, Lionel Hampton and George Benson, and she released her first music on record as part of homage to Mahalia Jackson. events.title: TSOMBANIS4
events.description: Tsombanis4, the quartet founded by the renowned tenor saxophonist Anna Tsombanis, is causing a sensation with its unusual line-up. With two double basses, saxophone and drums, the composer, who is known for her preference for low notes, explores the sound possibilities of the lower register and gives it plenty of space. She is joined by the Swiss bassist Andreas Waelti and the Austrian bassistist Beate Wiesinger, whose different timbres harmonise perfectly and complement each other. The ensemble is carried by drummer Herbert Pirker, whose energetic playing has a lasting impact on the sound of the quartet, while Anna Tsombanis explores new spheres with her full and warm tenor sound. The result is an explosive mixture of spontaneous communication and energetic playing in which the roots of traditional jazz can still be clearly felt.

events.title: DIE KUNST DER ORGIE & ORGIA OCCULTA
Tony Hurdle Invites TC THE 3RD – «United Nations Quartet» – Special Guest: TC THE 3RD
events.description: Tony Hurdle Invites TC THE 3RD «United Nations Quartet» Feat : Lionel Haas-Axel Obert-Andrea Marcelli Special Guest : TC THE 3RD In einer Welt, in der Hunger, Krieg, Rassismus und nie endendes Chaos herrschen, will das United Nations Quartett mit seiner Botschaft von Einigkeit, Frieden und Respekt vor den verschiedenen Kulturen Zeichen setzen und zeigen, dass durch die Musik, Menschen und Nationen zusammen kommen können. Durch vier hervorragende Musiker werden vier Nationen repräsentiert. Musikalische Schwerpunkte des Quartetts sind verschiedene Stilrichtungen des Jazz, angesiedelt im Spektrum zwischen Duke Ellington und Wayne Shorter. Tony Hurdle setzt Highlights durch Interpretationen von Komponisten, die hierzulande weniger bekannt sind, wie Jimmy Thompson, Leslie Ford und Felix Leach, welche allesamt aus der Gegend um Philadelphia / New Jersey stammen und mit namhaften Jazz-Größen aufgetreten sind. In der Besetzung mit Tony Hurdle mit Lionel Haas, Axel Obert, Andrea Marcelli, hat das U.N.Q. vier Jazzmusiker mit ganz individuellem, sehr unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zu einem einzigartigen Sound verschmolzen. Durch den hohen Anspruch an die eigene Arbeit entsteht eine Mischung, die den Zuhörer oft verblüfft, denn der Sound ist so raffiniert und klar, dass man den Eindruck gewinnt, die vier Musiker spielten schon mindestens seit zwanzig Jahren zusammen in verschiedenen Ensembles. TC THE 3RD is an accomplished jazz vocalist /producer and songwriter whose roots are embedded in Jazz by his parents, jazz organist Ms. Trudy Pitts and drummer Bill “Mr. C” Carney both are well-known and respected in the music industry. Born in Philadelphia he effectively carried the Philly sound of Jazz to New York and was quickly acclaimed by audiences as a “serious jazz vocalist worthy of recognition. TC has performed throughout the United States and Europe, Asia, and The Caribbean and has shared the stage with multiple jazz greats such as Shirley Horn, Gloria Lynne, Art Blakey, Wynton Marsalis, Duane Eubanks, and others. TC is a consummate producer, his concert “THE MEGA JAZZ EXPLOSION” was reviewed by the Philadelphia Tribune as the best in 30 years! And featured the concert was recorded and released as his first project, “TC III LIVE!!! Mega Jazz Explosion” His second was “She Do What She Do.” His project “THE MUSIC,” was recorded in 2021. He records with the best musicians in jazz such as Joey DeFrancesco, Lonnie Plexico, Gary Bartz, and more. TC is the recipient of the 2011 Jazz Vocalist of the Year Award presented by the Philadelphia Cub of Jazz and Performing Arts – and the 2005 Anheuser Bush Jazz Mobile Jazz Vocal Competition Award for Best Male Vocalist. Whether he is scatting, singing the lush lyrics of Cole Porter, the Ellington Songbook, or paying tribute to his favorite jazz greats Cab Calloway, Jon Hendricks, Eddie Jefferson, or Johnny Hartman, his sound is uniquely his own and one that enthralls audiences. TC THE 3RD is indisputably -The Voice of Jazz The United Nations Quartet is a Berlin-based jazz and funk ensemble led by Philadelphia-born trombonist, composer, and bandleader Tony Hurdle. If you are looking for a global political entity or an international diplomat, you may be thinking of a different name, as Tony Hurdle is a prominent musical artist rather than a UN official. About Tony Hurdle & The United Nations Quartet: The United Nations Quartet (sometimes billed as the United Nation Quartet) is one of several musical formations created by Hurdle. It features a rotating lineup of international musicians performing classic and modern jazz, soul, and blues. Tony Hurdle moved from Philadelphia to Germany in the early 1990s and has since become a mainstay of the Berlin jazz scene. In addition to the United Nations Quartet, he is highly celebrated for founding The Guardians of the Groove (a 1970s-style funk-jazz group), the Tony Hurdle Septet, and the Berlin Blackstompers. His groups perform frequently at famous Berlin jazz clubs like b-flat berlin, A-Trane, and the ZigZag Jazz Club.
